note: Effect identity, print identity and same-name grouping are separate mappings. Effect identities merge printings only on an identical canonical payload; none of the submitted printings is merged across products.

model.effect_identity: Canonical effect + rule attributes (class, category/tags, stats, abilities/attacks, special-card rule). Same-effect reprints share it only when the canonical payload is identical; a shared name is never enough.
model.print_identity: One concrete printing: print_code + printed number.
model.name_group_key: Key for the at-most-4 same-name construction rule. Official rules may declare different names to be one group (see environment reprint_provision name_identity_notes); effect identity is a separate axis.
